description.content:
Complete Postman collection for the E-Commerce platform.

Contains 6 requests covering the full user flow:
  1. Login (POST /api/auth/login)
  2. Get Products (GET /api/products)
  3. Add to Cart (POST /api/cart)
  4. Get Cart (GET /api/cart)
  5. Checkout (POST /api/checkout)
  6. Get Orders (GET /api/orders)

Each request includes:
  - Status validation
  - Response body assertions
  - AJV-style schema validation via Postman sandbox
  - Variable extraction for chaining requests
Base URL for the local Express backend
JWT auth token — set automatically by the Login request test script
Cart item UUID — set automatically by Add to Cart request test script
Order ID — set automatically by Checkout request test script
Test admin email address (matches backend/data/users.json)
